crossRefs.note: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
“You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple…
He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height…
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven…
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the…
And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
“You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of…
You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You…

translations.web: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
translations.bsb: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony, and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And thou shalt set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
